export function sumTo(n: number): number {
    //@ verify
    //@ requires (0 <= n)
    //@ ensures (\result >= 0)
    //@ decreases n
    return n === 0 ? 0 : n + sumTo(n - 1);
}
// main.vibe:12
export function total(n: number): number {
    //@ verify
    //@ requires (0 <= n)
    //@ ensures (\result === sumTo(n))
    let sum = 0;
    let i = 0;
    while (i < n) {
        //@ invariant (0 <= i)
        //@ invariant (i <= n)
        //@ invariant (sum === sumTo(i))
        //@ decreases (n - i)
        i = i + 1;
        sum = sum + i;
    }
    return sum;
}
